title: Exploring a Cost-Efficient Model for Predicting Cerebral Aβ Burden Using MRI and Neuropsychological Markers in the ADNI-2 Cohort.
summary: Supervised LR/SVM/boosted-tree/ANN and adaptive LASSO predict cerebral Aβ positivity in 724 ADNI-2 participants; demographics plus neuropsychological tests performed similarly to MRI combinations, with test AUC ~0.824–0.85. Retrospective cross-sectional ADNI baseline only.
ai_technology: §2.6 and §§3.2–3.3: supervised models classify Aβ status; adaptive LASSO selects interpretable variables.
organization: Interdisciplinary Program in Cognitive Science, Seoul National University, Seoul 100-011, Korea

evidence.unknown: Results are limited to the reported models, cohorts, datasets or experiments; broader generalization and clinical or operational benefit were not established.
